journal.title: Project start: corpus census
journal.text: Decided to build an open Hindi/English ↔ Garhwali model on the DGX Spark. First census of web text: only ~0.5M Garhwali words.

journal.title: 27 sources, 2.28M unique words
journal.text: Three research passes found Kukreti's e-magazine, Mamgain's blog, Kavita Kosh, PahariLI, Google's FLORES Garhwali. Char n-gram language ID built (99.7%).

journal.title: Gold eval set + first training
journal.text: 1,012 FLORES test sentences held out forever. Pilot LoRA on Qwen3-8B launched (7.8M tokens).

journal.title: Pilot scored: 43.5 chrF++
journal.text: Hindi→Garhwali 43.5 vs 33.8 zero-shot. The model writes real Garhwali grammar (अर, मजी, कु, छ, यख).

journal.title: ASR round 2: WER 0.75 → 0.51
journal.text: Full-encoder fine-tune of MMS-1B on 7,049 gold utterances. Adapter-only had plateaued at 0.71.

journal.title: 80 h of radio bulletins transcribed
journal.text: 463 Akashvani Garhwali bulletins → 24,042 segments → 469k words kept after confidence + language gates.

journal.title: Speech-to-speech demo works both ways
journal.text: English speech → Garhwali speech and Garhwali bulletin → English speech, end to end on the box.

journal.title: Spelling standard chosen; reviewer tool live
journal.text: Adopted the UOU CGL-103 consensus (Srinagari base). Review page hosted on GitHub Pages for Deepak and parents.

journal.title: Full run: same score as pilot
journal.text: 20M tokens → 43.6. Lesson: more of the same text is not the lever; variety, spelling normalisation, base model and reviewer gold are.

journal.title: v2 bidirectional run launched
journal.text: Corpus 2.71M words with bulletins and normalised spelling; 53.6k pairs both directions. 2,179 steps, ~19 h.

journal.title: v2 bidirectional model scored
journal.text: See scores table: first Garhwali→English numbers.

journal.title: v2 scored: Garhwali→English 58.9 chrF++
journal.text: First reverse-direction model: gbm→eng 58.9, gbm→hin 49.9. Into-Garhwali flat at 43.3: output quality is limited by Garhwali reading volume; back-translation next.

journal.title: Sarvam-M beats Qwen: English→Garhwali 50.8
journal.text: Same data, same steps: Sarvam-M pilot scores 44.3 hin→gbm and 50.8 eng→gbm vs Qwen 43.5 / 35.7. Sarvam-M is the base model from here.

journal.title: Sarvam-M pilot scored
journal.text: Base-model comparison against the Qwen pilot on identical data.

journal.title: Interactive learning page published
journal.text: Twelve modules from a single neuron to the pipeline, with widgets and quizzes, at /learn/. ASR round 3 epoch 1 scored 0.523, slightly worse than round 2 (0.513): the first 10k pseudo-labels did not help yet; epoch 2 pending.

journal.title: ASR round 3: MMS full encoder, gold + top-10k pseudo-labels from raw Vaani
journal.text: Loss decreased from 0.535 to 0.442, a 17.5% improvement. WER decreased from 0.523 to 0.503, a 3.8% improvement.

journal.title: ASR round 3: WER 0.503, new best
journal.text: Gold + 10,000 confident pseudo-labels from the raw Vaani hours; epoch 1 dipped to 0.523, epoch 2 reached 0.503 / CER 0.200. Bulletins now being re-transcribed with it. First reviewer corrections ingested (Roman words transliterated to Devanagari).

journal.title: First broadcast-speech gold: 19 reviewer clips
journal.text: On Deepak’s corrected bulletin clips, ASR round 2 scores WER 0.222 / CER 0.075 and round 3 scores 0.342: round 3 helped field speech but not radio. Caveat: corrections were edited from round 2 output, which favours round 2. Persistent speech server is up on the LAN (17 s per turn, models resident).

journal.title: Re-transcribe 80 h of bulletins with ASR round 3, rebuild bulletin corpus
journal.text: Retranscription of 80 hours of bulletins with ASR round 3 resulted in 17620 kept segments and 473,923 words. Compared to previous runs, the number of dropped segments for 'hin' (1852 -> ?) and 'kfy' (250 -> ?) increased, while the number of dropped segments for 'gbm' (660 -> ?) decreased.

journal.title: Back-translation data: 20k Garhwali paragraphs → Hindi + English with qwen3-8b-v2
journal.text: 20,000 human-written Garhwali paragraphs translated into Hindi and English by the v2 model: 40,000 pairs whose Garhwali side is real. Capped from 60,000 because generation ran at 0.6 paragraphs/s on this box.

journal.title: Data v3: v2 pairs + back-translated pairs
journal.text: 93,566 translation pairs: 53,566 bidirectional (Bible, FLORES dev, quads) + 40,000 back-translated. Sarvam-M v3 run started; first attempt was killed by memory pressure and retried with the demo server and local LLM unloaded.

journal.title: Dictionary drive: 12,700 lexicon records
journal.text: Deepak’s finds (Chatak 1959 grammar, a 124-page scanned dictionary, euttaranchal lessons) plus a research pass: Grierson 1916 word lists as open CSV, Kukreti’s 793-sentence Learn-and-Teach series, Kafal Tree, Omniglot, PahadiLingo and more. Scanned books queued for OCR with the local vision model after the Sarvam run.
